summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026 announcing definitive agreements to acquire a 50% equity interest in the business comprising Sandals and Beaches Resorts for a base cash purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion, with committed debt financing from Morgan Stanley. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, subject to customary approvals and closing conditions. The partnership expands Royal Caribbean into the all-inclusive resort space, combining Sandals and Beaches Caribbean hospitality expertise with Royal Caribbean's vacation brands and loyalty platform. No board recommendation, premium, or per-share price was disclosed.
